content.title: Chapter 30 - ELECTIONS — Sec. 30-61. - Councilmembers.
content.summary:
Any councilmember of the city may be recalled from office at any time after holding
               office for six months, in the manner provided in
section 3.6
of the Charter as supplemented by this article.
(Code 1981, § 11-32; Ord. No. 3511, § 2, 2-1-1999)
